channel.title: Maxlol Games – News and updates
channel.description: Maxlol Games news: updates and new features for La Dernière Torche, WYRMSTORM, Gravity Turn and Infinite Dungeon.

item.title: WYRMSTORM is here: a free dragon shoot'em up
item.description: WYRMSTORM joins the catalogue: a free dragon shoot'em up you play with one thumb, right in your browser.

item.title: You can now buy it with PayPal
item.description: The full version of La Dernière Torche can be bought with PayPal from the game page.

item.title: New studio intro
item.description: The studio home page now opens with a new intro that brings all the games together, with a short jingle.

item.title: 8 heroes, 28 costumes and voices
item.description: La Dernière Torche: 8 heroes, 28 costumes, and voices during battles.

item.title: Now at version 1.4
item.description: Gravity Turn is now at version 1.4.
